shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'for f in /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md /workspace/app/AGENTS.md; do if test -f "$f"; then printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; fi; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat app/page.tsx && cat app/layout.tsx && cat next.config.ts && cat tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx && cat lib/analytics.ts && cat .env.example'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
root = Path('/workspace')
build = root / '.next'
types = root / 'next-env.d.ts'
if build.is_dir():
    shutil.rmtree(build)
if types.is_file():
    types.unlink()
PY"
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --check && git diff -- app/page.tsx && nl -ba app/page.tsx && nl -ba lib/analytics.ts && nl -ba .env.example'
